name: cobuilder-memory
title: A memory plugin consults Hindsight for the main agent
outcome: plugins/cobuilder-memory installs from this marketplace and gives the main agent the consult tool. Haiku writes the recall query, picks a knowledge page, and writes reflect questions, all through the Hindsight MCP tools. Design and build call the tool, and a pane shows each run.
done_when: A session started with --plugin-dir plugins/cobuilder-memory lists mcp__cobuilder-memory__consult, and claude plugin validate accepts the marketplace entry. After the merge, one install from the GitHub marketplace works.
From the installed plugin, `$.mcp.call` returns data from recall, search_knowledge_base, get_knowledge_page, and reflect, and the MCP timeout is measured.
`claude plugin validate` and `claude plugin test` pass, and `uv run pytest tests -q` passes with the install-surface rule that ADR-0039 amends.
A consult call returns the judging rules first, then recall records with the current session's own transcript dropped.
When the page search finds a page with content, Haiku may pick one, and the result shows its body and update date. An empty page is never picked.
The reflect questions name at least one ADR id or term from the recall records when recall kept a record, and a failed reflect leaves the other answers intact.
The bank comes from bankIdTemplate and the main worktree's base name, and outside a git repo the run stops with a reason.
Each run opens or updates the memory pane as the approved mockup shows. A tool run shows it from 144 columns, and /memory-recall at any width.
Design stage 1 and implement Gate 1 call the consult tool when the session lists it, and the implement skill holds no H1 to H5 checkpoint.
Live runs on one design question in this repo and in think-with-ai return a dated record that the main agent uses or rejects with a stated reason.
abort_if: The installed plugin cannot call the hindsight MCP server through $.mcp.call.
The engine stops a tool.call hook before a run finishes.

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts (skills, scripts, docs), colliding ADRs 0016, 0017, 0025, 0035, 2 boundary rules (ADR-0025 install surface, generic stack card dependency rule)
min_work.note: Revision of 2026-10-15. It rests on the 2026-10-14 tool spike in ~/mods/cobuilder-memory.

epics.outcome: The plugin installs from this marketplace, consults Hindsight through its MCP tools, shows each run in the memory pane, and joins design stage 1 and implement Gate 1. H1 to H5 retire.
A Jev gate decides every n tool calls whether a consult would help.

The memory pane lists every Hindsight call of the session, with the plugin's own runs marked apart. Sources: the agent's mcp__hindsight__ tool calls, the runtime's diag.jsonl, and the Hindsight audit log.

rounds.note: Reviewer round on Haiku. The engineer chose N1 a, N2 a, N3 a, N4 a, and the 14 cosmetic fixes.
Reviewer round 2 on Haiku. The engineer kept M3 a (R2-1 a), chose the tool-less deep run as the S3 fallback (R2-2 a), and the 21 fixes.
The engineer cut the receipt, the note format, the check schema, the gap lines, and the memory citation. The Hindsight audit log records each call. Paired runs prove value.
The engineer cut the design to the spike shape plus a pane (stage 0, 2026-10-15) and moved the workflow wiring and a Jev gate to epic E2.
The engineer added knowledge pages as a source in E1 (D-B a) and epic E3, a pane list of every Hindsight call (D-A).

Reviewer round on Haiku: 10 cosmetic findings, no survivor. The judging rules come first, the run time is up to about five and a half minutes, empty pages are dropped, and the names are memory run and memory pane.

The engineer chose the Hindsight MCP tools over the HTTP API, moved the workflow steps into E1, named the tool consult, dropped SDK prompts, and approved the pane mockup. Slice 1 proves the installed plugin and each MCP tool.
